workflow_guidance.role: any Seedream model the user picked without a dedicated profile

known_limitations: Model id comes from the user's image source; sizes are the range every Seedream 5.0 model accepts.
No mask API: edits send the current raster as a reference with the instruction; deterministic composite enforces protected pixels.
Quality has no Ark equivalent and is not sent.
The adapter always disables Ark's default watermark.
Result URLs expire after 24 hours; the adapter requests base64.
